about_short_description.short_description: FLEX is a manufacturing and supply chain services.

product.name: Product Design and Engineering Services
product.description: Design and engineering support for developing, validating, and preparing electronic and connected products for production.

product.name: Electronics Manufacturing Services
product.description: Contract manufacturing of printed circuit board assemblies, electronic products, and integrated systems for original equipment manufacturers.

product.name: Mechanical Manufacturing and Systems Integration
product.description: Production of mechanical components, enclosures, assemblies, and complete electromechanical systems for finished products.

product.name: Supply Chain Solutions
product.description: Planning, sourcing, logistics, and supply chain management services that coordinate materials, suppliers, production, inventory, and distribution.

product.name: New Product Introduction Services
product.description: Processes and operational support for transferring a product from engineering design into repeatable, scalable manufacturing.

product.name: Aftermarket and Circular Economy Services
product.description: Repair, refurbishment, returns management, spare-parts logistics, recycling, and end-of-life services for products after initial sale.
